label: Frozen: three bench requirements after the static review. Measurement integrity, independent generalization, later consolidation. Does not change v3. Does not start the next ability.

requirements.measurement_integrity: Quality metrics must say whether evidence came from retrieval or was supplied from gold. Official comparisons require a named C@8 baseline, not the first run in a cache file.
requirements.independent_generalization: New legal formulations are tested without first adapting the rules to those formulations.
requirements.later_architectural_consolidation: Experimental proof rules are not production architecture. Do not stack them into the default controller.
